sentences.text: I cannot confirm that clause 7.4 complies from the evidence, because the current RBI finding for this case leaves pre-payment charges, if any, to the approved policy of the UCB, and the approved policy text for clause 7.4 is not in the evidence.
The floating-rate pre-payment prohibitions in the 2025 RBI directions are no longer in force on the as-of date, so they do not control this case.
The only in-force charge terms shown are a 2% pre-payment charge in one home-loan agreement and a 3% pre-payment charge in a copy of that agreement.
I did not find the text of retail loan policy clause 7.4 or evidence that it is the approved UCB policy referenced by the RBI finding, so that point remains missing.

missing.searched: retail loan policy clause 7.4 was not provided in the evidence set
evidence of the UCB approved policy referenced for pre-payment charges was not provided
no sanction date was provided, though it is needed for the para 260/261 findings
